evidence: Baranwal et al. arXiv:2209.09223 motivates counting distinct antisquare factors through avoidance thresholds.
RESULT.md §§2–4 establishes full count, sharp equality classification and mean.
value.rationale: Four alternating runs form the first family with both opposite-orientation three-run antisquares supported at two distinct interior centers. This natural first competing-center host family admits an exact count for arbitrary run lengths, a sharp universal length-minus-one ceiling with all maximizers, and the typical density seven-sixteenths. These together determine structural, extremal and average behavior of a classical factor invariant, not an isolated small-size census or a mere restatement of the published run-parity lemma.
residual_risks: The paper is deliberately restricted to four runs; significance is an exact natural restricted classification, not a claim about arbitrary binary words.
